title: LLM Role Policy
description: Business policy layer: maps agent roles to LLM providers and models. Single source of truth for role-model assignment. No infrastructure details here.

version.description: Semantic version of this policy file.

roles.description: Map of role name to model assignment. Role names must match llm_role fields in prompt_script_registry.json.

provider.description: Provider key matching a key in llm_providers.json.

model.description: Primary model name. Must exist in provider's available_models list.

secondary_model.description: Fallback model used when primary fails due to OOM, context overflow, or sustained timeout. Must exist in provider's available_models list.

retry_policy.description: Transport-layer retry policy. Applies to transient network errors only. Does NOT apply to OOM or provider-layer failures.

base_delay_ms.description: Base delay in ms. For exponential_backoff: attempt N waits base_delay_ms * 2^(N-1).

fallback_policy.description: Provider-layer failure policy. model_fallback: try secondary_model on OOM/overflow. fail_fast: throw immediately.
